lockout.billingPolicy.paragraph1: Starting January 1, 2025, all Entresoft members must provide payment information for features that incur charges within the platform. These billable features include, but are not limited to, the Phone System, Email System, Yext, WordPress, and Premium/AI Features. Charges are applied on a per-use basis, with the exception of recurring monthly fees for phone number selection and registration.
lockout.billingPolicy.paragraph2: Members are responsible for staying informed about these features and monitoring their charges through the Settings > Billing section in Entresoft.
lockout.billingPolicy.paragraph3: If you have a current Credit Balance in your Wallet, this will carry over. Rest assured you will not lose anything.
lockout.billingPolicy.paragraph4: If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact our Support Team at
lockout.billingPolicy.paragraph5: . A support ticket will be created, and we aim to respond within 48 hours.
lockout.billingPolicy.paragraph6: Thank you for your understanding and for choosing Entresoft. Have a great day.

usageLimit.note:
Enabling contacts limit will not stop creation of new contacts after the limit is reached. When the limit is reached for a sub-account, you will be notified of it and a prompt to upgrade will be shown on that sub-account.
Users limit on the other hand are enforced, and no new users can be added to a sub-account once it has reached the limit.
